notes.title: Release Candidate v3
notes.notes:
Added new music and updated visuals of button prompts.

Button prompts now emerge after ~15 seconds of no movement.
Different music in World and in Menu

notes.title: Release Candidate v2
notes.notes:
Updated loading to use Coroutines and added loading bar.
Updated Ending system such that the game identifies if a save is complete.

notes.title: Release Candidate v1
notes.notes:
This version is the release candidate for Melvin's Blocky Adventure.

Added in this:
- New background music
- Popup tutorial icons that matches the input type.

notes.title: Beta v4 now live.
notes.notes:
Fixes: 
 - Minor improvements to water graphics.
 - Removed particle clouds.
 - Added particles to better indicate depth and 3D movement of camera.
 - Removed shortcut from Ice-14.
 - Re-balanced SINK-09.
 - Remade SINK-14 to be more complex.
 - Settings are now properly loaded and saved.
 - Fixed better rocket-smoke effect on robot-children and on Melvin.

notes.title: Beta v3 hotfix
notes.notes:
A small bug with the new autoplay system introduced a bug that required the autoplay loop to be run for it to notice that no auto play should happen, Such as when a new game is started.

- Moved check outside of loop.

notes.title: Beta v3 is live
notes.notes:
Fixes and additions in Beta v3:

Puzzle design updates
[list]
[*] Puzzle Ice-12 is now solvable.
[*] Puzzle Ice-14 is now solvable.
[*] Puzzle Ice-16 is now solvable.
[*] Redesigned puzzle Ice-15 to make it harder and more interesting.
[*] Redesigned puzzle Ice-17 to make it harder and more interesting.
[/list]

Improvements
[list]
[*] Autosave should no longer cause framedrops that could affect the wave simulation.
[*] Added small animation in corner indicating when game is saving. Game autosaves everytime players enters a puzzle.
[*] Made the loading animation faster. Long games with many actions should no longer take 50+ seconds to animate, but maybe 5-8 seconds instead.
[*] Minor edits to how water interacts with ice. Waves should no longer pass through the ice.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta v2 released
notes.notes:
Beta v2 is here! The patch adds some polishing and optimizations and it fixes some bugs.

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed so that everything is based on the same underlying timers. Will help game feel snappier when playing on lower end systems.
[*] - Solved followup problems that emerged from the new timer system.
[*] Added rocket animation when placing down robots and for winning the game.
[*] - Created rocket smoke shader.
[*] Small tweaks to water simulation to better align simulation between systems.
[*] Fixed intro cinematic + fade between main menu and world not glitching.
[*] Fixed Tentacle 21 puzzle not being impossible to complete.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix: Settings creation
notes.notes: Fix a bug that prevented a settings file from being created and would lock up the generation of the main menu.

notes.title: Beta starts now!
notes.notes:
Melvin's Blocky Adventure has entered Beta!

The game is no playable from start to finish.
All known game breaking bugs have been fixed.

Now comes the time for balancing and fixing visual/audio problems and some smaller optimizations.

Join the beta and report any problems you find on the steam forums!

notes.title: Steam Integration patch.
notes.notes:
Fixed bugs relating to tiles being pushed outside of levels.

Fixed so that cinematic does not play when loading game where it has already played.

Added Steam Integration in the form of Steam Cloud Saves.

notes.title: Steam Cloud Saves!
notes.notes:
Melvin's Blocky Adventure now has the framework for steam integration.
With this update, steam cloud saves and cloud settings should work, with the potential to implement achievements and trading cards in the future.

notes.title: The UI Patch
notes.notes:
Updates for alpha v0.3 "The UI Update":

Bug fixes:
	- Moved away from Unity Time.time to avoid coupling gameplay to FPS
	- Updated all parametric animations to use no extra memory.
	- Fixed oscillating tentacle visuals
	- Fixed reseting tentacle-levels to fast prevented tentacle from spawning.
	- Fixed rotation of Melvin when reseting or undoing after being grabbed by tentacle.
	- Fixed unintented behaviour when reseting or undoing when a block is sliding.
	- Sound sliders now properly update correct values and produce the correct volume.


Features:
	- Remade UI to be visually nicer.
	- Remade UI navigation to be much clearer.
	- Flags are now saved to prevent playing cinematics or "puzzle complete" sound with each new load of the game.
        - Added Tools to teleport around the map for testers to test puzzles in a none-linear manner.
